{{Term/Store|Enhancing||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring mechanic in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="BotW Mija"/><ref name="TotK Cotera"/>

==Overview==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Main|Armor in Breath of the Wild}}
{{Stub|BotW}}
The four [[Great Fairy|Great Fairies]] can enhance [[Link]]'s [[Armor]] once Link pays a certain amount of [[Rupee]]s to restore their [[Great Fairy Fountain]]s. The restorations cost 100, 500, 1,000, and 10,000 [[Rupee]]s, increasing with each Great Fairy Fountain that Link unlocks.

Each Enhancement requires a certain amount of [[Material]]s.

Each Enhancement increases the [[Defense]] value of the Armor. The progression is consistent across Armors—all Armor with the same initial Defense value will also have the same Defense any any given Enhancement level. The progressions are as follows:

At any given level, all Armor pieces in an Armor Set have the same [[Defense]] value. Most require the same [[Material]]s to upgrade and have the same [[Sell Price]] as well—these Armor pieces are listed under the name of their Armor Set.

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Main|Armor in Tears of the Kingdom}}
{{Stub|TotK}}
Each Enhancement requires a certain amount of [[Material]]s and [[Rupee]]s. The required Rupees are 10 Rupees for ★, 50 Rupees for ★★, 200 Rupees for ★★★, and 500 Rupees for ★★★★ for all Armor except the [[Ancient Hero's Aspect]], which requires triple the amount of Rupees for each Enhancement (30, 150, 600, 1500).

At any given level, all Armor pieces in an Armor Set have the same [[Defense]] value. Most require the same [[Material]]s to Enhance and have the same [[Sell Price]] as well—these Armor pieces are listed under the name of their Armor Set
